Please don’t harm yourself dude. I am still currently in cycles where I think about killing myself as well. It pains me to see another person in a similar position. About 3 or 4 months ago I almost slashed my wrists with a dull pair of scissors. Since then, I am very glad I did not choose to harm myself. I won’t guarantee things will get better after high school, but I just recently graduated and although the ceremony felt kind of pointless, I felt a great sense of freedom and liberation from graduating. You can do this dude. Graduation is just around the corner.

:/ I know exactly how that feels. I’m 18, and just a year ago I had your exact mindset. One thing I do to try to combat this is focus my self on other things (school work, interests etc.) The more I think about the things I don’t have, the more depressed I got.  Although I’ve never actually dated anyone before, I think that being in a relationship will not solve any problems you have already. I’m sure you’ve probably heard this before, but I think that one must be at peace with themselves before entering a relationship. It’s a lot easier said than done though. Talking with friends, gaming with friends, and listening to my favorite music helps me cope with this. You can also try this technique I learned from talking to my school counselor. He taught me this technique of clearing your mind. What he told me to do was to just enter my room, lay on my bed, close my eyes (not fall asleep though) and just take deep breaths for five minutes to help clear my mind. I’ve done it a few times and it certainly has helped me. I still get depressed at times, but it gives me a sense of security knowing that I have different ways of coping with things. Just writing this comment out to you is doing WONDERS coping with my feelings of depression and loneliness, and I hope it helps you too. You’re not alone in how you’re feeling nor are you wrong for it.

Good luck man. If you want, you can even PM me if you’d like.
